# Django Hurricane

> The Kubernetes-Native Application Server for Django, powered by a high-performance Rust engine ([Granian](https://github.com/emmett-framework/granian) / Hyper / Tokio).

Django Hurricane connects Django directly to Kubernetes container lifecycles, health probes, Prometheus metrics, and edge security shields (Fast-404 and Token-Bucket Rate Limiter) without extra reverse proxies or boilerplates.

## Core Features

- **Rust-Powered HTTP Engine:** Built on [Granian](https://github.com/emmett-framework/granian) (Rust Hyper + Tokio), replacing Python event loops with zero-copy asynchronous I/O and native multi-core worker threads.
- **Zero-Config WSGI & ASGI Auto-Detection:** Automatically executes WSGI (`WSGI_APPLICATION`) or ASGI (`ASGI_APPLICATION`) based on project settings.
- **Native Kubernetes Probes:** Out-of-the-box `/startup`, `/alive`, and `/ready` probes synchronized via POSIX shared memory (`/dev/shm`).
- **Traffic Shedding Under Congestion:** Saturated worker backlogs (WSGI) or event loop lag (ASGI) automatically trigger HTTP 400 on `/ready` to shed Ingress traffic before pods crash.
- **First-Line Defense Shields:**
  - **Fast-404:** Intercepts bot/scanner dictionary attacks (`.php`, `/.env`, `wp-admin`) at the gateway in <50µs with zero Django overhead and silent drop logging.
  - **Rate Limiter:** Token-bucket rate limiter (default: 10 req/s, burst 30) with proxy header client IP extraction (`X-Forwarded-For`, `CF-Connecting-IP`, `X-Real-IP`).
- **Built-in Prometheus Metrics:** Exposes `/metrics` endpoint with request counts, average latency, queue depth, and a framework for custom application metrics.

## Quickstart

Install via `uv` or `pip`:
```bash
uv add django-hurricane
# or
pip install django-hurricane
```

Add to `settings.py`:
```python
INSTALLED_APPS = [
    # ...
    "hurricane",
]
```

Run server:
```bash
python manage.py serve --port=8000 --probe-port=8001
```

## CLI Reference (`manage.py serve`)

- `--port`: Application HTTP port (default: 8000).
- `--probe-port`: Probe/metrics port (default: port + 1). Set equal to `--port` for integrated routing.
- `--workers`: Number of worker threads / max concurrency ceiling (default: container CPUs + 4).
- `--runtime-threads`: Rust/Tokio runtime worker threads (default: detected container CPUs, capped at 4).
- `--req-queue-len`: Saturated queue threshold for readiness failure (default: workers * 2).
- `--fast-404`: Fast-404 mode (`auto`, `prefix`, `signature`, `off`).
- `--rate-limit`: Rate limit frequency (e.g. `10/s`, `off`).
- `--rate-limit-burst`: Token-bucket burst allowance (default: 30).
- `--rate-limit-proxy-header`: Header for client IP extraction (`X-Forwarded-For`, `CF-Connecting-IP`, `X-Real-IP`).
- `--max-memory`: Worker RSS memory limit in MB for graceful recycling (e.g. `400`).
- `--check-migrations-apply`: Check and apply pending DB migrations before marking `/startup` successful.

## Documentation Index

- [Getting Started Guide](https://django-hurricane.io/guides/getting-started): Quickstart and initial setup.
- [Kubernetes Deployment Guide](https://django-hurricane.io/guides/kubernetes-deployment): Production Deployment, Service, and HPA manifests.
- [Custom Prometheus Metrics Guide](https://django-hurricane.io/guides/custom-metrics): Developing custom Counter, Stored, Calculated, and Observed metrics.
- [Reverse Proxies & Ingress Guide](https://django-hurricane.io/guides/reverse-proxies): Setting up Cloudflare, Nginx, and Ingress-Nginx.
- [Configuration Reference](https://django-hurricane.io/configuration/settings): Complete list of all CLI flags and Django settings.
- [Django on Kubernetes vs. Gunicorn](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/django-kubernetes-vs-gunicorn): Architectural comparison of running Django in Kubernetes with Hurricane vs Gunicorn and uWSGI.
- [ASGI vs. WSGI Architecture](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/asgi-vs-wsgi): Concurrency models and event loop lag tracking.
- [Rust Engine Architecture](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/rust-engine): How Hurricane's Rust engine, Hyper, and Tokio operate.
- [Kubernetes Probes](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/kubernetes-probes): Deep dive into `/startup`, `/alive`, and `/ready`.
- [Fast-404 Protection](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/fast-404-protection): Gateway-level scanner mitigation.
- [Rate Limiting](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/rate-limiting): DoS and flood prevention.
- [POSIX Shared Memory Metrics](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/shared-memory-metrics): Cross-process atomic metrics architecture.
- [Webhooks](https://django-hurricane.io/concepts/webhooks): Cluster notification lifecycle webhooks.
- [Benchmark Suite Overview](https://django-hurricane.io/performance/benchmark-suite): Empirical benchmarks evaluating WSGI and ASGI deployments across 7 workload routes.
- [Kubernetes Scaling & Pod Constraints](https://django-hurricane.io/performance/kubernetes-scaling-findings): Impact of small pod resource constraints (1-2 vCPUs), thread starvation, and probe flapping prevention.
- [Conclusions & Architecture Recommendations](https://django-hurricane.io/performance/architecture-recommendations): Architectural decision tree, partial async trap, and production deployment checklists.
